IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CRIMINAL WRIT PETITION NO.2273 OF 2025
Bhavesh Kalia .... Petitioner
     versus
The State of Maharashtra & Anr. .... Respondents
…....
• Mr.  Vishwajeet  Surve  a/w  Mr.  Amit  Karkhanis  a/w  Ruchita 
Chavan a/w Sakshi Jadhav a/w Suchitra Ballal, Advocate for 
Petitioner.
• Smt. M. M. Deshmukh, APP for the State/Respondent.
• Mr. Kunal Jha, Advocate for Respondent No.2.
CORAM :  SARANG V. KOTWAL &
S. M. MODAK, JJ.
DATE :  28th APRIL, 2025
P.C. :
1.  This  Petition  is  filed  for  quashing  the  proceedings 
arising out of C.R. No.209/2025 registered with Kandivali Police  
Station,  on  21/03/2025,  u/s  78,  356(2)  of  Bharatiya  Nyaya 
Sanhita, 2023. As far as section 356(2) is concerned, there was a 
separate  procedure  provided,  but  as  far  as  section  78  is 
concerned, the investigation is going on. At this stage, since the 
investigation  is  going  on,  we  expressed  our  disinclination to 
grant relief in this Petition.
Nesarikar
MANUSHREE
NESARIKAR
Digitally
signed by
MANUSHREE

2.  Learned  counsel  for  the  Petitioner,  on  instructions, 
sought permission to withdraw this Petition at this stage, with  
liberty to adopt appropriate proceedings in accordance wi th law, 
if and when the charge-sheet is filed against the Petitioner.
3.  Considering this request, the Petition is allowed to be  
withdrawn with such liberty.
4.  The Petition is disposed of as such.
(S. M. MODAK J.) (SARANG V. KOTWAL, J.)
